summary: Capital Lux 2: Pocket is a quick tactical card game about deciding whether to keep character cards for personal points or feed them into a shared capital to trigger useful powers everyone benefits from. Its modular power combinations keep it feeling fresh across plays despite a short runtime and small footprint.
praised: compact box with high replayability from mixable powers
meaningful push-and-pull between personal and shared benefit
criticised: can feel a bit dry or abstract for some
power combination variance means some setups are stronger than others
limited long-term strategic depth compared to bigger card games

interaction.kind: drafting from a shared row and choosing whether to feed a shared capital pool others can use
interaction.detail: On a turn you draft a character card from a shared offer and decide whether to keep it for your own scoring or place it into the shared capital, where its power becomes available to opponents as well as you. Most of the scoring itself happens on each player's personal tableau, but the shared draft row and shared capital area are genuinely contested.

sources: points from character cards kept in your home base
bonuses granted by capital powers you triggered
scoring.how_you_win: You win by having the most total points after several rounds, balancing cards kept for direct home-base points against cards donated to the shared capital for its powers.
